あらすじ

An adventure sequel set in a fantasy world ruled by sword and magic.

Shortly after the bandits are vanquished from the village, their evil influence

returns to disrupt the heroic sisters’ lives. Queruca is tortured and

enslaved in the underground bandit lair.

Rinna and Helvetica infiltrate the lair, but all three girls are overpowered.
